objective: Canario 2/6: comprobar unicamente tipo y nullability de PersonaID en dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.

queries.name: personaid_type_null
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID'
